# 13-week bills issued during last week of April 1972-1974: $2.3 billion each (from excerpt: four 91-day issues of $2.3 billion)
# Question asks how many of these 13-week bills exceeded nominal amount outstanding of 2400 millions USD
# 13-week issues = 2300 million per the 1972 excerpt; only 1972 data provided
# Treating the issued amount as 2300 million

issued_amounts = {
    1972: 2300,
    [redacted]: 2300,
    1974: 2300,
}

threshold = 2400

count = sum(1 for v in issued_amounts.values() if v > threshold)

# geometric mean of the amount outstanding values
import math
vals = list(issued_amounts.values())
prod = 1
for v in vals:
    prod *= v
geo = prod ** (1/len(vals))

print(f"[{count}, {round(geo,2)}]")
